Booth Library in Center has been digging up dinosaur facts all summer long.

Their "Unearth A Story" reading program wraps up this month — and if you've got kids who participated, they've earned it. Storytime, crafts, dinosaur fossils, and a whole lot of books checked out.

Good things happen when a community invests in its library. Shelby County is lucky to have one worth showing up for.

Seventy-three years ago this week, the armistice was signed that ended the Korean War — a conflict that claimed the lives of more than 36,000 Americans, including men from Shelby County.

VFW Post 8904 held a remembrance ceremony at the Veterans Memorial in Center on Sunday morning — reading names, playing Taps, and making sure those who served are not forgotten.

If you know a Korean War veteran or a family who lost someone in that conflict, this week is worth a phone call.

Thank you to VFW Post 8904 for keeping these names alive.
